question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Method**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Method **refers to a systematic or organized way of doing something, a procedure, or a technique for achieving a particular result. (किसी कार्य को करने का एक व्यवस्थित या संगठित तरीका, एक प्रक्रिया, या एक तकनीक)

 
 
• **Example**: *In the laboratory, scientists followed a meticulous method to conduct experiments and gather accurate data.*
 
 
 
• In this context, "**method**" is used to describe the systematic and organized procedure or process by which the state exercises its authority to administer the death penalty.
 
• It underscores the structured and regulated approach that is followed within the legal framework when implementing capital punishment.

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Custody: **Legal or physical control and care, especially of a person under arrest or of a child. (कानूनी या शारीरिक नियंत्रण और देखभाल, विशेषकर गिरफ़्तार व्यक्ति या बच्चे का)
 
• **Intention: **Purpose or plan in mind; the aim or objective behind an action. (मन में कोई उद्देश्य या योजना; किसी कार्य के पीछे का लक्ष्य या उद्देश्य)
 
• **Lawyer: **A professional trained in and licensed to practice law, providing legal advice and representation. (कानून का अभ्यास करने के लिए प्रशिक्षित और लाइसेंस प्राप्त पेशेवर, कानूनी सलाह और प्रतिनिधित्व प्रदान करता है)
